aboutText: Once Upon A Tile is Hawthorn's trusted tiling specialist, delivering exceptional craftsmanship for bathrooms, kitchens, and more. With a focus on quality and customer satisfaction, we transform your ideas into stunning reality. Our team ensures every project, from waterproofing to epoxy grouting, exceeds expectations and enhances your space's aesthetic appeal. We handle all aspects with integrity and skill.
servicesText: We offer a complete range of tiling services in Hawthorn, including waterproofing, bathroom and kitchen installations, re-grouting, and epoxy grouting. Our team manages every step, from initial consultation to final touches, ensuring a seamless process and stunning results that match your style.

services.title: Waterproofing
services.desc: Professional waterproofing solutions to prevent leaks and damage in wet areas like bathrooms and kitchens.

services.title: Bathroom Tiling
services.desc: Expert installation of tiles for bathroom floors, walls, and showers, creating a stylish and functional space.

services.title: Kitchen Tiling
services.desc: Custom tiling for kitchen backsplashes, floors, and countertops, tailored to your design preferences.

services.title: Re-grouting
services.desc: Restoring grout lines to refresh the look of existing tiles, improving hygiene and appearance.

services.title: Epoxy Grouting
services.desc: Durable and stain-resistant epoxy grout application for long-lasting, easy-to-clean surfaces.

services.title: Mosaic Tiling
services.desc: Artistic mosaic installations that add unique character and visual interest to any room.
